{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = (deduplicated_data['severity'] == 'severe').sum()
total_patients = len(deduplicated_data)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f'Severe count: {severe_count}')
print(f'Total patients (deduplicated): {total_patients}')
print(f'Fraction severe: {fraction_severe}')"}
